commentary.text: 90+3' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+2' Barcelona work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+1' Barcelona quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Barcelona comes to nothing.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kike Perez departs the field of play to be replaced by Cenk Ozkacar (Valladolid).
88' Paulo Pezzolano has decided to make a change. Victor Andres Meseguer Cavas (Valladolid) replaces Raul Moro.
85' 7 - 0 It's a goal! Lamine Yamal plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Ferran Torres (Barcelona). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 7:0.
84' Isidro Diaz de Mera shows a yellow card to Mario Martin (Valladolid), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
83' Substitution. Dani Olmo is replaced by Pablo Torre (Barcelona).
82' 6 - 0 Dani Olmo (Barcelona) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to release a low effort which ends up in the bottom right corner.
81' The total number of attempts is 15:6.
76' Barcelona fail to score from a corner as Karl Hein (Valladolid) leaps to collect the ball.
74' Kike Perez (Valladolid) is cautioned by the referee.
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ferran Torres (Barcelona) is coming onto the pitch as Robert Lewandowski cannot continue after picking up an injury.
72' 5 - 0 Goal! A great through ball by Lamine Yamal sets up Raphinha (Barcelona) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball low into the middle of the goal. 5:0.
71' Valladolid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
71' Kike Perez (Valladolid) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Valladolid.

70' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Barcelona are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
64' 4 - 0 Raphinha (Barcelona) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems fires the ball into the back of the net.
62' Ivan Sanchez is substituted due to injury. Paulo Pezzolano gives a chance to Mario Martin (Valladolid).
61' Hansi Flick decides to make a substitution. Pau Cubarsi will be replaced by Sergi Dominguez (Barcelona).
61' Substitution. Pedri leaves the pitch and is replaced by Fermin Lopez (Barcelona).
61' Substitution. Marc Casado makes his way off the pitch and Eric Garcia (Barcelona) comes on as his replacement.
60' Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
58' Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Isidro Diaz de Mera blows for a foul.

57' OFF THE POST! Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the right post! It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valladolid.
57' Paulo Pezzolano has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Chuki (Valladolid) replacing Selim Amallah.
56' Substitution. Marcos Andre will be replaced by Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid).

55' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but Karl Hein shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
54' Barcelona take a short corner kick.
54' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play and Barcelona manage to earn a corner.
53' Barcelona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
50' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid will have a goal kick.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+2' 3 - 0 Jules Kounde (Barcelona) is the first to get to a rebound inside the penalty area and his weak, but precise effort finds its way through the defenders into the top right corner, bouncing in off the post.
45+2' Barcelona will take a corner kick.
45+2' The resulting set piece from Barcelona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

45+1' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall charges down the ball. The ball goes behind for a corner. Barcelona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45+1' Barcelona get the opportunity to endanger the opposition's goal with a free kick from the edge of the box.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' Javier Sanchez (Valladolid) gets a yellow card. The referee Isidro Diaz de Mera made the right call.
42' POST! Dani Olmo (Barcelona) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the right post. What a strike that was!
38' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
37' Raul Moro (Valladolid) is flagged offside not for the first time in this match.
31' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
29' Barcelona force a corner. They send men into the box.

26' Kike Perez (Valladolid) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.

24' 2 - 0 Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) meets a perfect cross from Lamine Yamal deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces a low shot into the middle of the goal. The score has changed to 2:0.
24' The linesman raises his flag. Raul Moro (Valladolid) is adjudged offside.
23' Flag goes up against Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
20' 1 - 0 Goal! Pau Cubarsi plays a pass to the feet of Raphinha (Barcelona), and he shoots into the bottom left corner from inside the box. It's 1:0.
19' One of the players from Valladolid times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
17' None of the Barcelona players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

17' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) meets a fine cross from inside the penalty area from the resulting free kick and attempts to beat the keeper with a sweet header. That he does, but one of the defenders standing on the goal line manages to stop the effort going inside the left post. Now Barcelona have a corner.
16' Dangerous play by Kike Perez (Valladolid). Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle for a foul.
15' Karl Hein (Valladolid) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
14' The ball is laid off to Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players low towards the middle of the goal and forces Karl Hein to make a decent save.
12' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
10' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Dani Olmo (Barcelona) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
7' Raul Moro (Valladolid) sends a cross into the box, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen comes off his line to gather the ball.
7' Barcelona are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
5' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) misses a big chance! He got to the rebound inside the penalty box but placed the ball only against the right post!
3' Stanko Juric (Valladolid) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
1' The first half has started.
Valladolid will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Isidro Diaz de Mera.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
